answer.rationale: Hard constraint is no added delivery risk: the primary expires in 14 days with no auto-renew, the line is at 94% with zero buffer, and a missed shipment dominates any unit-cost win. That rules out switch (c2’s quick onboarding is not evidenced to fit this window and cannot be a guarded test) and defer (c5 was non-critical month-to-month). Add-second-source does not replace the expiring primary. Incumbent already refused to reopen price, so negotiate_terms is unlikely this cycle. Renew preserves integration (c1). Verifying c6 only, to see whether a longer term can still recover some cost without a vendor change; 18% spend cut remains unmet and uncertain.
